branding.requirement: Use Hammill branding in the rebuilt add-in description, command groups, windows, help, and distribution package.

icons.requirement: Provide a consistent family of small and large native ribbon icons, with labeled concept previews for user selection before producing final assets. Use Hammill green #729403 as the primary brand accent, retaining neutral material colors where appropriate. Component Display has no button or icon.

approach: Add-in commands with shared Solid Edge integration, plus independently maintained standalone macros discovered by Hammill Macro Launcher.

macroLauncher.initialPackaging: Separate launcher module with its own COM identity; preserve the legacy add-in during migration.
macroLauncher.folderSource: User Macro Manager settings.xml local element; use its Documents/Add-ins default only when no local preference is saved.
macroLauncher.discovery: Read local .se-manager package manifests with stableCopies=1; select one stable main EXE per package, with explicit overrides for ambiguous packages.
macroLauncher.refresh: Each Solid Edge startup/add-in connection; advance the managed GUI version only when the catalog or presentation changes.
macroLauncher.launch: Run only the macro whose button is clicked, using its executable directory as the working directory.
macroLauncher.configuration: Optional HammillMacros.xml in the user's local install folder controls name, group, environment, icon, enabled state and an explicitly selected manifest-owned executable.
macroLauncher.customizationNote: A changed GUI version rebuilds this add-in's cached ribbon and may reset its customized button placement or shortcuts; verify in live SE testing.

scopeDecision.requestedExclusions: Remove dimension formatting, Fill Hole Table, Bolt Finder, Turbo Ballooning, and Turbo Callout from the rebuilt suite.
scopeDecision.legacyFiles: Preserve the original binaries and supporting files as recovery references. This scope file does not change an installed add-in.

commands.name: O-Ring Finder
requestedChanges: Extract O-Ring Finder into a standalone EXE; no add-in registration or legacy DLL dependency.
Read Oring_table.txt from beside the running EXE instead of the embedded ORing4 resource; allow selection of an external table.
Reload the table on startup, on Reload table / assembly, and before applying a size so edits take effect without recompiling.
Preserve the existing comma-separated table format: part number, nominal width, and inside diameter in inches.

tableSource.pathBase: running-executable-directory; optional --table path or session file selection
tableSource.validation: Validate the table before selecting any sizes or changing any part properties. Report missing files and invalid rows clearly; do not silently use old embedded data.
tableSource.distribution: Include the table alongside the EXE. Builds preserve an existing output table. Macro Manager updates replace packaged files, so back up customized installed tables or keep the authoritative table outside the package and select it with --table.

migrationChecks: Preserve O_ and O- part-name recognition and the ID and WD dimension conventions.
Verify size selection, units, pressure options, and external Oring_table.txt data.
Verify that editing the external table affects the next invocation without rebuilding and that missing or invalid files stop processing clearly.
Review property changes and document saving before migrating the acceptance action.

commands.name: Add Sketch
migrationChecks: Verify reference-plane selection and requested sketch count against the 2026 API.
Handle unavailable documents and invalid selections with clear errors.

commands.name: Component Display
migrationChecks: Preserve applicable UC_, REF_, NORM_, UNDO_, THRD, and TB display rules after reviewing their exact scope.
Verify the legacy command-event trigger against the 2026 SDK.
Verify behavior for nested assembly and part drawing-view members.

commands.name: Occurrence Viewer
migrationChecks: Preserve show/hide criteria and optional subassembly traversal.
Verify every property filter and visibility result with representative assemblies.

commands.name: Batch Approval/export
migrationChecks: Verify drawing DWG/PDF and assembly STEP/3D PDF export support and options.
Review file naming, destination selection, existing-file handling, and source-document state.

pendingRequirements: Specific behavior changes requested for retained commands.
